question: The arteries divide into small tubules. On reaching the tissues, they further divide into thin tubes called ____.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Capillaries**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **Capillaries** are tiny blood-containing structures that **connect arteries and veins.**
 
• Capillaries are **small enough to penetrate body tissues.**
